title: FLY Mobile App
description: Fresh Lifelines for Youth (FLY) works with over 2,000 justice-impacted youth in the Bay Area. We built a a mobile app so youth can access legal resources through gamified learning, connect with mentors, and track goals. Currently in beta testing, stay tuned!

title: MECA Mobile App
description: The Middle East Children's Alliance (MECA) supports Palestinian families through aid and education, and works to raise awareness and promote meaningful solidarity with over 60,000 followers on social media. We developed a mobile app for followers to read stories, see events, shop merchandise, and donate to fundraisers. I built the backend systems for push notifications and serverless APIs on AWS Lambda, API Gateway, SNS, and S3. Check it out on the App Store and Google Play!

title: SingaporeConnect Ticketing Platform
caption: Bay Area Festival 2025
description: SingaporeConnect is a Bay Area nonprofit for Singaporeans and friends of Singapore. I built the payment service for their 2025 festival, which had over 3,000 attendees: Stripe webhooks on Express.js, and React screens for buying and assigning tickets.

title: AssessAble
caption: LA Hacks 2025 - Healthcare Track
description: AssessAble is a mobile application that helps older adults prevent falls by detecting hidden home hazards through photo or video scans. It provides personalized, ADA-aligned safety recommendations and visual mockups, empowering seniors to age safely and independently in the homes they love.

title: pill.ai
caption: LA Hacks 2024 - Healthcare Track Winner
description: pill.ai is an AI-powered platform that prevents prescription errors by verifying medication images and doctor-patient audio using Google's Gemini API. It empowers patients to take charge of their medication with a user-friendly dashboard, enhancing medication safety.

title: JARVIS Health
caption: TreeHacks 2025 - Healthcare Track
description: JARVIS Health is a tablet application designed to monitor soldiers' health during training. It aggregates heart rate and exertion data from wearable devices via the Terra API, providing commanders with a real-time overview of multiple soldiers' physical states. The platform uses OpenAI's GPT-4 models to analyze data and offer actionable insights, supporting data-driven decisions for safer and more effective training.

title: Personal Website
caption: My Portfolio & Learning Space
description: I created this site to document my projects and experiences while exploring Vue and front-end development. Having primarily worked with React, this project provides an opportunity to discover new ways of building with Vue. The site is very much a work in progress, and I see it as a space to experiment freely, learn through building, and continuously improve. Thanks for stopping by!

title: remembrall
caption: UCLA CS35L Final Project
description: Built with the PERN stack, this full stack web application helps users manage tasks effectively. It features an interactive drag-and-drop task list, a friends system, and dynamic search filters, making task management intuitive, collaborative, and efficient.
